title: Arrears to Approval: Getting a Second Mortgage When Payments Are Behind
summary:
Homeowners face financial difficulties because they cannot pay their mortgage. The arrival of letters increases, phone calls rise, and upcoming deadlines create a sense of urgency. Homeowners in Ontario experience payment difficulties due to unexpected life events, including job loss, illness, relationship breakdowns, and expenses exceeding their income. A private lender's second mortgage can be a practical solution when traditional banks refuse to assist after missed payments. Borrowers on a repayment plan can achieve financial control through their stabilization efforts, which will help them escape the power of sale legal actions.
